title: 首都圈外郭放水路
titleEn: Metropolitan Area Outer Underground Discharge Channel
summary: 首都圈外郭放水路由入流設施、地下水路、調壓水槽與泵站共同減少洪水影響，官方圖列水路6.3公里。2002年先行運用的是部分3.3公里區間，工程期至2006年。本課以水量、能量及水位基準串接全系統，避免把地下河道誤當道路隧道或將局部算例當完整洪水演算。
summaryEn: The Metropolitan Area Outer Underground Discharge Channel combines intakes, a 6.3 km underground waterway, a pressure-control tank and pumps. Interim use in 2002 covered a 3.3 km portion; construction continued to 2006. This course connects water balance, energy and level datum without treating the facility as a road or a local calculation as full flood routing.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「地下水路與傳遞時間」與「洪水歷線與調蓄餘量」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Underground water routes and travel time" and "Flood hydrographs and storage reserve": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 地下水路與傳遞時間：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Underground water routes and travel time: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「水體平流時間」如何影響首都圈外郭放水路的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Water advection time” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Metropolitan Area Outer Underground Discharge Channel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 首都圈放水路收集多河川入流，教材以水體平流時間辨認路徑，明確區別洪峰波速與控制延遲。地下排水或引水設施的路線先由集水區、入流點、出口水位及坡度定義，不能以交通旅行時間衡量。定速水體的行程可用距離除速度估算，但洪峰波速、蓄水與回水會改變訊號傳遞；各支路必須在共同水位與時間基準下連接。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「水體平流時間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The channel receives several rivers; use material advection to identify a route while distinguishing flood-wave celerity and control delay. An underground water route is defined by catchments, inflows, outfall level and gradient, not vehicle journey time. Distance divided by velocity estimates constant-speed material travel, while flood-wave celerity, storage and backwater alter signal propagation. Branches must be connected using common level and time references before interpreting arrival or control response. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Water advection time” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：水路長度=2350 m；水體速度=1.5 m/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: reach length=2350 m; water velocity=1.5 m/s. t=L/v/60=26.1111 min.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「水體流過全程的時間必然等於洪峰抵達的時間。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Material travel time necessarily equals flood-peak arrival time." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「水體平流時間」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Water advection time”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 地下水路與傳遞時間
knowledge.titleEn: Underground water routes and travel time
knowledge.text: 首都圈放水路收集多河川入流，教材以水體平流時間辨認路徑，明確區別洪峰波速與控制延遲。地下排水或引水設施的路線先由集水區、入流點、出口水位及坡度定義，不能以交通旅行時間衡量。
knowledge.textEn: The channel receives several rivers; use material advection to identify a route while distinguishing flood-wave celerity and control delay. An underground water route is defined by catchments, inflows, outfall level and gradient, not vehicle journey time.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：水體流過全程的時間必然等於洪峰抵達的時間。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Material travel time necessarily equals flood-peak arrival time. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「首都圈外郭放水路」的「地下水路與傳遞時間：機制與系統路徑」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出地層、地下水、開挖邊界與支撐的介面，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「隧道模型掘進交班」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與地質假設、監測位置、時間順序及基準點版本的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Underground water routes and travel time: mechanism and system paths” in “Metropolitan Area Outer Underground Discharge Channel”. Draw the ground, groundwater, excavation boundary and support interfaces; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Tunnel model drive handover” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for ground assumptions, monitoring locations, time order and benchmark version, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 關於「地下水路與傳遞時間」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Underground water routes and travel time" is correct?
options: 水體流過全程的時間必然等於洪峰抵達的時間。
首都圈放水路收集多河川入流，教材以水體平流時間辨認路徑，明確區別洪峰波速與控制延遲。
泵站名目排水量大於平均入流就不需要調蓄容積。
optionsEn: Material travel time necessarily equals flood-peak arrival time.
The channel receives several rivers; use material advection to identify a route while distinguishing flood-wave celerity and control delay.
Nominal pumping above mean inflow eliminates the need for storage.
quiz.explanation: 首都圈放水路收集多河川入流，教材以水體平流時間辨認路徑，明確區別洪峰波速與控制延遲。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The channel receives several rivers; use material advection to identify a route while distinguishing flood-wave celerity and control delay. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 地下水路與傳遞時間：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Underground water routes and travel time: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「水體平流時間」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Water advection time” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：水路長度=2350 m；水體速度=1.5 m/s。t=L/v/60=26.1111 min。僅把水路長度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為28.7222 min。邊界：定速水體平流，不是洪峰波速或完整洪水演算；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: reach length=2350 m; water velocity=1.5 m/s. t=L/v/60=26.1111 min. Increasing only reach length by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 28.7222 min. Boundary: Constant-speed water advection, not flood-wave celerity or complete routing. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對齊各支路和出口的流量水位時序。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Align branch and outlet flow-level histories.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：水路長度=2350 m；水體速度=1.5 m/s。t=L/v/60=26.1111 min。僅把水路長度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為28.7222 min。邊界：定速水體平流，不是洪峰波速或完整洪水演算；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: reach length=2350 m; water velocity=1.5 m/s. t=L/v/60=26.1111 min. Increasing only reach length by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 28.7222 min. Boundary: Constant-speed water advection, not flood-wave celerity or complete routing. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「地下水路與傳遞時間」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Underground water routes and travel time", which statement holds?
options: 跌水位能功率可直接當作豎井壁的均勻壓力。
目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。
原創教學假設：水路長度=2350 m；水體速度=1.5 m/s。
optionsEn: Drop potential-energy power can be used directly as uniform shaft-wall pressure.
No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
Original teaching assumptions: reach length=2350 m; water velocity=1.5 m/s. t=L/v/60=26.1111 min.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：水路長度=2350 m；水體速度=1.5 m/s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: reach length=2350 m; water velocity=1.5 m/s. t=L/v/60=26.1111 min. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 地下水路與傳遞時間：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Underground water routes and travel time: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「水體平流時間」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Water advection time” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 對齊各支路和出口的流量水位時序。對齊入口與出口水位流量時間序列，利用允許的示蹤或模型比較平流時間與洪峰時差，保留回水條件。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Align branch and outlet flow-level histories. Align inlet and outlet level-flow histories; use permitted tracer data or modelling to distinguish material travel from peak lag while preserving backwater conditions. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「水體平流時間」的交付需回答：對齊各支路和出口的流量水位時序。路線圖同時標示水位基準、支路與控制邊界，所有時間比較註明是物質、波峰或設備延遲，避免混用。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Metropolitan Area Outer Underground Discharge Channel, the water advection time handover must address the following evidence: Align branch and outlet flow-level histories. Route diagrams show level datum, branches and control boundaries; label each time as material travel, wave propagation or equipment delay.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：用交通速度或單一平流時間預測洪峰都會失去水理意義。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Vehicle speed or one advection time cannot predict flood-peak routing. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 對齊各支路和出口的流量水位時序。對齊入口與出口水位流量時間序列，利用允許的示蹤或模型比較平流時間與洪峰時差，保留回水條件。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Align branch and outlet flow-level histories. Align inlet and outlet level-flow histories; use permitted tracer data or modelling to distinguish material travel from peak lag while preserving backwater conditions. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「水體平流時間」的交付需回答：對齊各支路和出口的流量水位時序。路線圖同時標示水位基準、支路與控制邊界，所有時間比較註明是物質、波峰或設備延遲，避免混用。
knowledge.textEn: For Metropolitan Area Outer Underground Discharge Channel, the water advection time handover must address the following evidence: Align branch and outlet flow-level histories. Route diagrams show level datum, branches and control boundaries; label each time as material travel, wave propagation or equipment delay.

quiz.question: 要驗證「地下水路與傳遞時間」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Underground water routes and travel time"?
options: 對齊各支路和出口的流量水位時序。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
多支水位計讀值相同就能排除共同零點偏差。
optionsEn: Align branch and outlet flow-level histories.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Matching readings from multiple sensors exclude a shared zero-point bias.
quiz.explanation: 對齊各支路和出口的流量水位時序。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Align branch and outlet flow-level histories. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 地下水路與傳遞時間：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Underground water routes and travel time: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「水體平流時間」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Water advection time” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 用交通速度或單一平流時間預測洪峰都會失去水理意義。把平流時間當洪峰預警時間會忽略波速和支路入流，控制指令可能在假定水體到達之前已失去適用性。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Vehicle speed or one advection time cannot predict flood-peak routing. Using advection time as flood-warning time ignores celerity and side inflows, allowing control assumptions to fail before the assumed arrival. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：定速水體的行程可用距離除速度估算，但洪峰波速、蓄水與回水會改變訊號傳遞；各支路必須在共同水位與時間基準下連接。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Branches must be connected using common level and time references before interpreting arrival or control response.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「水體流過全程的時間必然等於洪峰抵達的時間。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Material travel time necessarily equals flood-peak arrival time." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 用交通速度或單一平流時間預測洪峰都會失去水理意義。把平流時間當洪峰預警時間會忽略波速和支路入流，控制指令可能在假定水體到達之前已失去適用性。
knowledge.textEn: Vehicle speed or one advection time cannot predict flood-peak routing. Using advection time as flood-warning time ignores celerity and side inflows, allowing control assumptions to fail before the assumed arrival.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「地下水路與傳遞時間」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Underground water routes and travel time" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
用交通速度或單一平流時間預測洪峰都會失去水理意義。
泵站名目排水量大於平均入流就不需要調蓄容積。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Vehicle speed or one advection time cannot predict flood-peak routing.
Nominal pumping above mean inflow eliminates the need for storage.
quiz.explanation: 用交通速度或單一平流時間預測洪峰都會失去水理意義。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Vehicle speed or one advection time cannot predict flood-peak routing. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 洪水歷線與調蓄餘量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Flood hydrographs and storage reserve: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「淨入流調蓄量」如何影響首都圈外郭放水路的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Net-inflow storage” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Metropolitan Area Outer Underground Discharge Channel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 調蓄量由入出流歷線積分決定，教材研究下游高水位限制排放時的庫容消耗。調蓄設施以流入減流出的時間積分決定蓄水變化，最大入流量並不單獨決定所需庫容。下游高水位可能限制排水，水位與可用庫容也不是固定比例；需同時檢查初始蓄水、泵站可用性與洪水歷線的時序。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「淨入流調蓄量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Storage follows integrated inflow minus outflow; examine reserve depletion when downstream high water limits discharge. Storage change is the time integral of inflow minus outflow, so peak inflow alone cannot determine required capacity. High downstream levels can restrict discharge, and level is not always proportional to volume. Initial occupancy, pump availability and hydrograph timing must be assessed together rather than assuming the facility starts empty with unrestricted outflow. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Net-inflow storage” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：入流=173 m³/s；出流=100 m³/s；時間段=20 min。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: inflow=173 m³/s; outflow=100 m³/s; interval=20 min. ΔV=(Qin−Qout)Δt×60=87600 m³.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「泵站名目排水量大於平均入流就不需要調蓄容積。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Nominal pumping above mean inflow eliminates the need for storage." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「淨入流調蓄量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Net-inflow storage”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 洪水歷線與調蓄餘量
knowledge.text: 調蓄量由入出流歷線積分決定，教材研究下游高水位限制排放時的庫容消耗。調蓄設施以流入減流出的時間積分決定蓄水變化，最大入流量並不單獨決定所需庫容。
knowledge.textEn: Storage follows integrated inflow minus outflow; examine reserve depletion when downstream high water limits discharge. Storage change is the time integral of inflow minus outflow, so peak inflow alone cannot determine required capacity.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：泵站名目排水量大於平均入流就不需要調蓄容積。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Nominal pumping above mean inflow eliminates the need for storage. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「洪水歷線與調蓄餘量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Flood hydrographs and storage reserve" is correct?
options: 泵站名目排水量大於平均入流就不需要調蓄容積。
只算穩態流量就能排除輸水隧道的水錘與氣囊。
調蓄量由入出流歷線積分決定，教材研究下游高水位限制排放時的庫容消耗。
optionsEn: Nominal pumping above mean inflow eliminates the need for storage.
A steady-flow calculation excludes water hammer and trapped air in a conveyance tunnel.
Storage follows integrated inflow minus outflow; examine reserve depletion when downstream high water limits discharge.
quiz.explanation: 調蓄量由入出流歷線積分決定，教材研究下游高水位限制排放時的庫容消耗。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Storage follows integrated inflow minus outflow; examine reserve depletion when downstream high water limits discharge. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 洪水歷線與調蓄餘量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Flood hydrographs and storage reserve: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「淨入流調蓄量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Net-inflow storage” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：入流=173 m³/s；出流=100 m³/s；時間段=20 min。ΔV=(Qin−Qout)Δt×60=87600 m³。僅把入流增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為108360 m³。邊界：矩形歷線單一時段，真實洪水需逐時積分與水位約束；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: inflow=173 m³/s; outflow=100 m³/s; interval=20 min. ΔV=(Qin−Qout)Δt×60=87600 m³. Increasing only inflow by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 108360 m³. Boundary: One rectangular-hydrograph interval; real floods need time integration and level constraints. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：閉合水位庫容和逐時流量帳，保留初始蓄水。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Close level-volume and time-step flow balances with initial storage retained.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：入流=173 m³/s；出流=100 m³/s；時間段=20 min。ΔV=(Qin−Qout)Δt×60=87600 m³。僅把入流增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為108360 m³。邊界：矩形歷線單一時段，真實洪水需逐時積分與水位約束；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: inflow=173 m³/s; outflow=100 m³/s; interval=20 min. ΔV=(Qin−Qout)Δt×60=87600 m³. Increasing only inflow by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 108360 m³. Boundary: One rectangular-hydrograph interval; real floods need time integration and level constraints. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「洪水歷線與調蓄餘量」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Flood hydrographs and storage reserve", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：入流=173 m³/s；出流=100 m³/s；時間段=20 min。
頂板平均彎矩不大就不必檢查柱頭沖切及基礎差異。
混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: inflow=173 m³/s; outflow=100 m³/s; interval=20 min. ΔV=(Qin−Qout)Δt×60=87600 m³.
Small mean roof bending eliminates column punching and differential foundation checks.
Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：入流=173 m³/s；出流=100 m³/s；時間段=20 min。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: inflow=173 m³/s; outflow=100 m³/s; interval=20 min. ΔV=(Qin−Qout)Δt×60=87600 m³. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 洪水歷線與調蓄餘量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Flood hydrographs and storage reserve: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「淨入流調蓄量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Net-inflow storage” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 閉合水位庫容和逐時流量帳，保留初始蓄水。將入出流歷線與水位庫容曲線閉合，測試不同初始水位和下游回水，檢查流量資料的時間間隔。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Close level-volume and time-step flow balances with initial storage retained. Close inflow-outflow hydrographs against the level-volume curve, test initial levels and downstream backwater and check sampling intervals. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「淨入流調蓄量」的交付需回答：閉合水位庫容和逐時流量帳，保留初始蓄水。交付可重算的逐時水量帳，標記起始水位、泵狀態與邊界洪水；控制決策依核准模型和即時量測而非單段算式。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Metropolitan Area Outer Underground Discharge Channel, the net-inflow storage handover must address the following evidence: Close level-volume and time-step flow balances with initial storage retained. Deliver a reproducible time-step balance with initial level, pump state and boundary flood; control decisions use approved models and observations, not one interval.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：假設設施全空且泵始終滿流會低估最高水位。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Assuming empty storage and full pumping throughout understates maximum level. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 閉合水位庫容和逐時流量帳，保留初始蓄水。將入出流歷線與水位庫容曲線閉合，測試不同初始水位和下游回水，檢查流量資料的時間間隔。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Close level-volume and time-step flow balances with initial storage retained. Close inflow-outflow hydrographs against the level-volume curve, test initial levels and downstream backwater and check sampling intervals. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「淨入流調蓄量」的交付需回答：閉合水位庫容和逐時流量帳，保留初始蓄水。交付可重算的逐時水量帳，標記起始水位、泵狀態與邊界洪水；控制決策依核准模型和即時量測而非單段算式。
knowledge.textEn: For Metropolitan Area Outer Underground Discharge Channel, the net-inflow storage handover must address the following evidence: Close level-volume and time-step flow balances with initial storage retained. Deliver a reproducible time-step balance with initial level, pump state and boundary flood; control decisions use approved models and observations, not one interval.

quiz.question: 要驗證「洪水歷線與調蓄餘量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Flood hydrographs and storage reserve"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
閉合水位庫容和逐時流量帳，保留初始蓄水。
設備有兩台就可以直接把各自故障率相乘判定安全。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Close level-volume and time-step flow balances with initial storage retained.
Two units allow their failure probabilities to be multiplied directly to establish safety.
quiz.explanation: 閉合水位庫容和逐時流量帳，保留初始蓄水。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Close level-volume and time-step flow balances with initial storage retained. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 洪水歷線與調蓄餘量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Flood hydrographs and storage reserve: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「淨入流調蓄量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Net-inflow storage” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 假設設施全空且泵始終滿流會低估最高水位。以日平均流量代替短時洪峰會低估最高水位，泵可用卻無法克服下游水頭也會造成錯誤出流假設。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Assuming empty storage and full pumping throughout understates maximum level. Daily mean flow misses short peaks and underestimates maximum level; an available pump may still fail to discharge against the downstream head. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：下游高水位可能限制排水，水位與可用庫容也不是固定比例；需同時檢查初始蓄水、泵站可用性與洪水歷線的時序。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Initial occupancy, pump availability and hydrograph timing must be assessed together rather than assuming the facility starts empty with unrestricted outflow.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「泵站名目排水量大於平均入流就不需要調蓄容積。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Nominal pumping above mean inflow eliminates the need for storage." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 假設設施全空且泵始終滿流會低估最高水位。以日平均流量代替短時洪峰會低估最高水位，泵可用卻無法克服下游水頭也會造成錯誤出流假設。
knowledge.textEn: Assuming empty storage and full pumping throughout understates maximum level. Daily mean flow misses short peaks and underestimates maximum level; an available pump may still fail to discharge against the downstream head.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「洪水歷線與調蓄餘量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Flood hydrographs and storage reserve" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
只算穩態流量就能排除輸水隧道的水錘與氣囊。
假設設施全空且泵始終滿流會低估最高水位。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A steady-flow calculation excludes water hammer and trapped air in a conveyance tunnel.
Assuming empty storage and full pumping throughout understates maximum level.
quiz.explanation: 假設設施全空且泵始終滿流會低估最高水位。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Assuming empty storage and full pumping throughout understates maximum level. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
